correctness.rationale: Every hypothesis and normalization is explicit; normalized monomial integration yields the beta spectrum. An exact forward beta difference makes the spectrum unimodal; a positive covariance proves strictly increasing crossover, and the weighted mean bounds endpoints. A uniform gamma-ratio and exponential-envelope proof establishes the profile, maximum, all real positive Schatten moments, and effective-rank limit. Exact kernel-trace evaluation confirms rho*h. Standalone finite checks passed 3960 assertions but are not infinite proofs.

originality.rationale: The known full beta-prime eigenvalue representation is not new (Abreu–Mouayn–Voigtlaender, Proposition 4.1). Novelty assessed only for the exact fixed-area single-annulus maximizing-mode staircase, its strict transition monotonicity, full gamma boundary spectral profile, sharp norm, all q>0 Schatten moments, and h-independent effective-rank coefficient. In the inspected primary material these conclusions are not stated, and the general radial formula alone does not imply them without the new monotonicity and scaling arguments. Historical priority remains provisional.
residual_risks: An unindexed earlier beta-prime integral asymptotic or radial Toeplitz limit theorem could imply the claimed constants without matching language; full historical exhaustion is impossible.
The known general radial eigenvalue formula makes the raw eigenvalue identity non-original. Novelty depends specifically on the sharp optimization and moving-annulus spectral limits.
Earlier general trace-asymptotics literature was inspected at abstract level only; an exact special-case formula outside the inspected full text cannot be categorically excluded.

value.rationale: Holding hyperbolic area fixed while moving an annulus toward the boundary is a canonical wavelet localization test motivated by Faber–Krahn shape optimization and annular uncertainty principles. The theorem uniquely determines every maximizing frequency, proves sharp gamma-mode localization at frequency n~rho*u, and quantifies delocalization through fixed total trace, a collapsing sharp norm, a continuum of Schatten asymptotics and an area-independent effective rank. These are nontrivial structural invariants of a naturally parameterized family, not the known diagonal beta formula alone.
